description: A game-agnostic reader/writer for Xbox Connected Storage (wgs) save folders used by Game Pass titles: containers.index, container manifests, blobs, ETag and sync-state handling, snapshots, orphan discovery and safe write ordering. Game-specific payload handling plugs in through adapter interfaces.

Command-line tool for Game Pass (Xbox Connected Storage, "wgs") save folders: list containers, diagnose health, extract and replace blobs, take whole-folder backups, and fingerprint a store before and after a cloud sync.

Game adapter for Abiotic Factor's Game Pass saves: classifies containers, reads a world bundle's table of contents without decompressing it, decodes the settings ini, names orphaned worlds and refuses writes while the game runs.
